note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; rule texts are the author's illustrative text, not statements of any law. Relationship kinds are drawn exactly as supplied (a causal arrow only where 'causal' is supplied) and every joint state is shown only as supplied.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Four long attributes and conditions (several lines each), long titles and component labels, long relationship captions, two assumptions and a long open issue.

facts.title: Incident at the north gate of the community garden, Friday evening

attributes.text: A heavy wheelbarrow full of soil was left standing across the main gravel path
The wheelbarrow carries the painted number of the Plot 12 holder on its side
A neighbour says she saw it there at about 21:40, after sunset
No sign was placed next to it to warn other visitors

rules.title: Community garden rule 4 on shared paths — fictional wording only
conditions: An object of any kind is left standing on a path that all members share
by a person who holds a plot in the garden at the time
after the garden has been closed for the evening by the warden
without a warning sign placed next to the object

issues.text: At what time did the warden actually close the garden that Friday evening?

assumptions: The main gravel path counts as a shared path for everyone
The neighbour's account is recorded in full
